name: Iris
description: The blind Oracle of Ephara of Meletis, whose gift of foresight comes from touch; she falls in love with her bodyguard Alexio.

timeline.summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
timeline.quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

timeline.summary: Alexio is presented as Iris's bodyguard; when she touches him she has a vision that he will fall in love with her and be taken from her, and resolves to prevent it.
timeline.quote: He was in love with her.

timeline.summary: Iris and Alexio leave Meletis at dawn on the overland route south through the forest.
timeline.quote: Perisophia let go of Iris's hand as Alexio led her horse away

timeline.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
timeline.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

timeline.summary: Alexio brings a friendly pegasus as a mount, and Iris and Alexio fly toward the mountains.
timeline.quote: Hold fast, but know that he will not let you fall.

timeline.summary: A storm forces them to land and shelter in a mountain cave.
timeline.quote: Alexio led them into a cave on the side of the mountain.

timeline.summary: Iris and Alexio become lovers in the cave, Iris deciding that she may be able to change his fate by loving him back.
timeline.quote: Before she could control herself, she felt his lips touch hers.

timeline.summary: Ambushers attack the cave; Alexio finds the back entrance blocked by a spider web and is shot while clearing it.
timeline.quote: Another arrow twanged through the cavern, this time finding its mark.

timeline.summary: Alexio sends Iris away on the pegasus and stays to fight, telling her he loves her; Iris senses he will die.
timeline.quote: She knew he would never make it out of that cave, his mighty body and heavenly wings doomed.

timeline.summary: Iris blames herself for Alexio's death and flies west toward freedom instead of to Soli or Meletis.
timeline.quote: The Oracle of Ephara flew blindly through the rain toward freedom, unseeing and alone, as she had always truly been.

timeline.summary: Mabel retrieves her family's fang-sword from the attic and its sigils glow for the first time.
timeline.quote: The sigils on the blade briefly gave off a faint reddish light

relations.note: Alexio is assigned as her bodyguard.
relations.quote: My duty is to see you safely to the garrison at Soli.

relations.note: They become lovers in the cave.
relations.quote: She tilted her head toward him and parted her lips.

relations.note: Iris is Mabel's mother and guardian of the artifact.
Iris is Mabel's mother who passed on the sword.
relations.quote: Mabel's mother Iris had said when she passed it on to her daughter.

Mabel's mother, the guardian of the family artifact.
Mabel's mother, who passed on the fang-sword.
